hook: orphan 謊言團排測謊：fabricate／prevaricate／equivocate／dissemble——休息室標語「請先喝水再說」。
script: fabricate 捏造。prevaricate／equivocate 含糊回避。dissemble 掩飾。mendacious 說謊的。canard 謠傳。口令：測謊儀寫「直說」，含糊寫「別繞」。

members.senseAnchor: to avoid giving direct answers to hide the truth
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 繞彎: prevaricate walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「繞彎」出場：prevaricate 一上場梗就黏住——含糊其詞。

members.senseAnchor: be deliberately ambiguous or unclear in order to mislead or withhold information
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 雙義嘴: equivocate walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「雙義嘴」出場：equivocate 一上場梗就黏住——模稜兩可。

members.senseAnchor: an unfounded or false, deliberately misleading story
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 謠傳單: canard walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「謠傳單」出場：canard 一上場梗就黏住——謠言。

members.speakLineEn: Cue the 假光澤: specious walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「假光澤」出場：specious 一上場梗就黏住——似是而非的。

members.speakLineEn: Cue the 好人卡: dupe walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「好人卡」出場：dupe 一上場梗就黏住——欺騙。

members.speakLineEn: Cue the 好騙臉: gullible walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「好騙臉」出場：gullible 一上場梗就黏住——易受騙的。

members.speakLineEn: Cue the 測謊儀: polygraph walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「測謊儀」出場：polygraph 一上場梗就黏住——測謊儀。
members.vocabNote: 留在幽默庫作構詞／劇本用；暫不列入 GRE 難詞主庫，避免稀釋考點密度。
